gap_scope.total: H3-compatible high-watermark frontier deficit through the explicit observed service end; includes necessary/unknown withdrawals.
gap_scope.classified: Union of actual loss windows within one canonical root and Owner epoch. Next canonical/epoch boundaries truncate continuation unless frontier coverage is actually restored there.
gap_scope.avoidable: Complete-path-compatible canonical clear; observed same-root area only, not a reconstructed full cross-root legally-supported G.
gap_scope.restoration: Actual visible audio frontier reaches the pre-drop frontier; this does not assert byte-identical text restoration.
gap_scope.removed_audio_seconds: Cumulative adjacent frontier drops; not a deduplicated fraction of offered input.
gap_scope.non_additive: Classified root-bounded areas do not partition full high-watermark area; separately classified window areas may overlap.
